security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's have_mseccfg() CSR existence predicate at target/riscv/csr.c:775 gates mseccfg access on ext_smepmp, ext_zkr, or ext_smmpm, but omits ext_zicfilp. The spec (Sm >= 1.12 AND anyOf{Zkr, Smmpm, Zicfilp}) requires mseccfg to exist when Zicfilp is the sole qualifying extension. A VM configured with only Zicfilp (and Sm >= 1.12) will receive RISCV_EXCP_ILLEGAL_INST on mseccfg access, blocking guest software from reading/writing the MSECCFG_MLPE forward-CFI control bit, yet QEMU's mseccfg_csr_write already contains a branch handling ext_zicfilp for MLPE — confirming the CSR was intended to be reachable.
security_spec.summary: have_mseccfg() predicate omits Zicfilp from mseccfg existence check, denying guest access to MSECCFG_MLPE forward-CFI control when Zicfilp is the only implemented field-bearing extension
